
DESCRIPTION
Run workspace tasks with Process Compose

USAGE
  one run [task] [flags]

EXAMPLES
  one run
  one run build -p web
  one run test -p api
  one run build --dry-run

TIPS
Lists tasks with no arguments. Runs supported static tasks from mise.toml through official Process Compose; mise prepares tool versions. one <task> is shorthand for one run <task>. Built-in commands take precedence. One TUI shows running tasks above the full dependency tree. Tab switches focus; y copies logs; c enables native terminal copying.

COMMON OPTIONS
  --concurrency <value>    Compatibility flag; limits below the number of command tasks are unsupported by Process Compose
  --dry-run                Preview tasks without preparing tools, dependencies, secrets, or caches
  --env <value>            One project environment name
  --force                  Bypass freshness checks and execute tasks
  --list                   List available tasks
  -o, --output <value>     Output format: json | yaml | text (default: terminal-friendly text, JSON when piped)
  -p, --project <value>    Project name or relative path (repeatable)
  --ui <value>             Output mode: auto, stream, tui, or raw
  --verbose                Show task sources, cache and interactive settings when listing tasks
